site.name: NexGrid
site.tagline: Distributed AI compute. Earn from your idle devices.
site.description: NexGrid turns idle phones and dedicated compute devices into AI inference capacity. Download the app to start.

hero.title: Your phone is the AI cluster.
hero.subtitle: Idle devices run AI inference and get paid in USDT. Start free — no hardware required.

path.freeDesc: Install the app and your phone's idle NPU starts running AI tasks. No hardware, no deposit.
path.scaleDesc: Dedicated devices multiply your compute capacity — datacenter-hosted, active from day one.
path.note: Real-time earnings are transparent in the app — every task, every payout.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Desc: Install the app and connect your phone's idle compute. Setup takes about 90 seconds.
how.step2Desc: Your device picks up inference jobs — image, language, speech — in the background. Nothing extra to do.
how.step3Desc: Every completed task settles to your in-app balance.

devices.title: One network, every scale
devices.subtitle: Start with the phone in your pocket. Scale with dedicated, datacenter-hosted hardware.

tagline.phone: The zero-cost entry — the device you already own.
tagline.cloud-share: A slice of shared compute, no hardware at all.

trust.title: Verify us yourself
trust.subtitle: Don't take our word for it. Company registration and compliance records are public — here's how to check them.
trust.pendingNote: Entity verification details are being finalized for publication.
trust.pocBody1: Every completed task generates an inference receipt — what ran, when, and what it earned. Receipts are recorded on the platform ledger with on-chain attestation.
trust.pocBody2: Your app shows the full receipt trail for every payout, so earnings are traceable end to end.

social.rolesLine: Engineers, teachers, drivers, students, designers — people all over the world put their idle devices to work.

mission.title: Compute that serves progress
mission.lead: The network's capacity powers real AI workloads — the kind that move research and everyday products forward.

footer.disclaimer: Earnings vary with network demand, device performance, and uptime, and are not guaranteed. Nothing on this site is financial advice.
